description:
[Calculators] Plant grow time, clones per cut, yield bonus and water use. The farm planner page's maths (https://rust.wiki/calculators/farm-planner): time to ripe = the plant's base time
/ (1 + 25% per G), x1.5 unfertilized; `stages` splits it into Seed, Seedling, Sapling, Fruiting and Mature to ripe;
`yield_bonus_pct` is +25% per Y; `clones_per_cut` adds one per two Y; water is per plant per tick, +10% per W.
Harvests are relative (Facepunch publishes no base amounts). For the best gene layout use /calculators/genetics/best.

fertilized.description: Ground condition 100% (fertilizer). Unfertilized takes about half as long again.

genes.description: The clone's six genes from G, Y, H, W, X.

plant.description: Crop: hemp, corn, pumpkin, potato, wheat, sunflower, rose, orchid, red_berry, blue_berry, green_berry, yellow_berry, white_berry, black_berry (or its name).

planter.description: Planter: planter.large, planter.small, planter.triangle, bathtub.planter, minecart.planter, plantpot.single.
